metadata.description: kmx agent authoring and testing for Copilot. Choose Windows/WSL or macOS/PATH.

plugins.name: kmx-agent-builder
plugins.description: Windows Copilot through WSL. Requires kmx v0.9.0-rc.3 at /usr/local/bin/kmx in the default WSL distribution.

plugins.name: kmx-agent-builder-path
plugins.description: macOS Copilot, or Linux with kmx on PATH. Requires kmx v0.9.0-rc.3 on the Copilot process PATH. Not the Windows/WSL variant.
